binding_defect.headline: The counts[] schema carries no field naming which subject a per-surface count belongs to. In a multi-subject record the binding is carried only by the prose inside the display text / source_sentence, and guard G-9 forbids the rubric from parsing those. Positional binding would be a guess, and a wrong guess puts one surface's shortfall on another surface's page.
binding_defect.handling: An unbindable per-surface count contributes "a comparison is on record" (W3, N7/S7) and never a counted warrant (W4/W5) or a matched-Excel state (N5/N6/S5/S6).
binding_defect.repair: Add counts[].subject (or counts[].subject_ids) to the evidence-record schema. The rubric already reads it and will bind immediately on the next run.
